connector.name: QrVerloz
connector.registryDescription: QR codes active 90 days, claimable forever. Request an API key in chat to retarget and track scans.
connector.summary: Hosted at qrverloz.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the neoshrek account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for authentication. Format: 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'. Request a free API key using the request_api_key tool directly in chat.
